'''Kavsun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he asked an Imperial to take down the [[Brig Stompers]] mercenary group.
